verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। श्रुतं दानफलं तात यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् । अन्नदानं विशेषेण प्रशस्तमिह भारत ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said I have heard, O sire, of the merits of the different kinds of gift which you have described to me. I understand, O Bharata, that the gift of food is especially praiseworthy and superior.

verses.sanskrit: पानीयदानमेवैतत्कथं चेह महाफलम् । इत्येतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण पितामह ॥२॥
verses.english: What, however, are the great merits of making gifts of drink. I wish to hear of this in full, O grandfather.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथावद्भरतर्षभ । गदतस्तन्ममाद्येह शृणु सत्यपराक्रम ॥३॥
verses.english: Bhishma said I shall, O chief of Bharata's race. relate to you this subject. Listen to ine, O you of unbaffled prowess, as I speak to you.

verses.sanskrit: पानीयदानाप्रभृति सर्वं वक्ष्यामि तेऽनघ । यदन्नं यच्च पानीयं संप्रदायाश्नुते नरः ॥४॥
verses.english: I shall, O sinless one, describe to you gifts beginning with that of drink. The merit that a man wins by making gifts of food and of drink is such that the like of it, I think, is incapable of being acquired by any other gift. There is no gift, superior to that of either food or drink. It is from food that all living creatures are able to exist.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्मात्परमं दानं किञ्चिदस्तीति मे मनः । अन्नात्प्राणभृतस्तात प्रवर्तन्ते हि सर्वशः ॥५॥
तस्मादन्नं परं लोके सर्वलोकेषु कथ्यते । अन्नाद्बलं च तेजश्च प्राणिनां वर्धते सदा ॥६॥
verses.english: Therefore, food is considered as a very superior object in all the worlds. From food the strength and energy of living creatures continually increase.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदानमतस्तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठमाह प्रजापतिः । सावित्र्या ह्यपि कौन्तेय श्रुतं ते वचनं शुभम् ॥७॥
verses.english: Hence, the master of all creatures has himself said that the gift of food is a very superior gift. You have heard, O son of Kunti, what the auspicious words are of Savitri herself.

verses.sanskrit: यतश्च यद्यथा चैव देवसत्रे महामते। अन्ने दत्ते नरेणेह प्राणा दत्ता भवन्त्युत ॥८॥
verses.english: You know why those words were said what those words were, and how they were said in course of the sacred Mantras, O you of great intelligence. A man, by making a gift of food, really makes a gift of life itself.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणदानाद्धि परमं न दानमिह विद्यते । श्रुतं हि ते महाबाहो लोमशस्यापि तद्वचः ॥९॥
verses.english: There is no gift in this world which is superior to the gift of life. You are not unacquainted with this saying of Lomasha, O you of mighty arms.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणान्दत्त्वा कपोतय संम्प्राप्तं शिबिना पुरा । तां गतिं लभते दत्वा द्विजस्यान्नं विशांपते ॥१०॥
verses.english: The end that was attained to formerly by king Shivi on account of his having granted life to the pigeon is acquired by him, O king, who makes a gift of food to a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विशिष्टां गच्छन्ति प्राणदा इति नः श्रुतम् । अन्नं वापि प्रभवति पानीयात्कुरुसत्तम ॥११॥
verses.english: Hence, we have heard that they who give life attain to very superior regions of happiness in after life. Food, O best of the Kurus, may or may not be superior to drink.

verses.sanskrit: नीरजातेन हि विना न किञ्चित्संप्रवर्तते ॥११॥
verses.english: Hence, we have heard that they who give life attain to very superior regions of happiness in after life. Food, O best of the Kurus, may or may not be superior to drink.

verses.sanskrit: नीरजातश्च भगवान्सोमो ग्रहगणेश्वरः । अमृतं च सुधा चैव सुधा चैवामृतं तथा ॥१२॥
verses.english: Nothing can exist without the help of what comes from water. The very lord of all the planets, viz., the illustrious Soma, has originated from water.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नौषध्यो महाराज वीरुधश्च जलोद्भवाः । यतः प्राणभृतां प्राणाः संभवन्ति विशांपते ॥१२॥
verses.english: Nothing can exist without the help of what comes from water. The very lord of all the planets, viz., the illustrious Soma, has originated from water.

verses.sanskrit: देवानममृतं ह्यन्नं नगानां च सुधा तथा । पितॄणां च स्वधा प्रोक्ता पशूनां चापि वीरुधः ॥१३॥
verses.english: From these, O king, the vital airs of all living creatures flow. The deities have nectar for their food. The Nagas have Sudha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नमेव मनुष्याणां प्राणानाहुर्मनीषिणः । तच्च सर्वं नरव्याघ्र पानीयात्संप्रवर्तते ॥१५॥
verses.english: The departed manes have Svadha for their. The animals have herbs and plants for their food. The wise have said that rice, etc., form the food of human beings.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पानीयदानाद्वै न परं विद्यते क्वचित् । तच्च दद्यान्नरो नित्यं यदीच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः ॥१६॥
verses.english: All these, O king originate from water. Hence, there is nothing superior to the gift of water or drink.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं जलदानामिहोच्यते । शत्रूंश्चाप्यधि कौन्तेय सदा तिष्ठति तोयदः ॥१७॥
verses.english: If a person wishes to get prosperity for himself, he should always make gifts of drink. The gift of water is considered as very laudable. It brings on great fame and bestows long life on the giver.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामानवाप्नोति कीर्तिं चैव हि शाश्वतीम् । प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नाति पापेभ्यश्च प्रमुच्यते ॥१८॥
verses.english: The giver of water, O son of Kunti, always stands over the heads of his enemies. Such a person obtains the fruition of all his desires and acquires everlasting fame.

verses.sanskrit: तोयदो मनुजव्याघ्र स्वर्गे गत्वा महाद्युते । अक्षयान्समवाप्नोति लोकानित्यब्रवीन्मनुः ॥१९॥
verses.english: The giver, O king, becomes purged of every sin and obtains unending happiness hereafter as he proceeds to the celestial region. O you of great splendour. Manu himself has said that such a person acquires regions of endless bliss in the other world.
